plan.narrative: The start-up is cutting everyone to 40% next year, so I won't stay there — once the master's is done I'll look for a full-time job elsewhere, which the simulator does anyway. Until then I keep spending tight, and I accept that the last study year may dip into overdraft: there's nothing left to cut, so a small dip is the price of finishing the master's. Once I'm earning properly I build the CHF 40'000 deposit, then move in with my partner and look for something bigger. If cash runs low later on, I sell investments back into cash rather than let the overdraft grow; if I lose a job, I cut back straight away.
